messages:
lena: Quick sync — SOC2 PoP evidence routing: need to confirm final owner for signing artifacts (envelope keys stored in KMS/HSM). Compliance fieldwork asked for per-tenant key_id + HSM attestation nonce in logs. Who owns final artifact generation + upload? cc @sam @mike

sam: I can take the pipeline work (ingest -> sign -> store). Need the exact log fields and the PR for the auditlog ingester. @zoe can you confirm schema?

mike: Draft PR is up https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4798 — currently only has raw log shipping. Will need to add key_id and attestation fields. WIP, but stubbed out.

zoe: Confirmed — include key_id, attestation_nonce, and attestation_cert_version. Also add signature_alg for future proofing. Prefer storing cert refs (attestation_cert_ref) not raw cert blobs. I can review once fields are added.

lena: Sounds good. Sam — can you add a short schema snippet in the PR description? e.g.

```json
{
  "key_id": "string",
  "attestation_nonce": "string",
  "attestation_cert_ref": "string",
  "signature_alg": "string"
}
```

sam: Will do. I'll add the JSON schema + unit test. Also, compliance asked about retention for PoP artifacts — they mentioned 3 years. Is that something we can configure automatically? @audit-bot any guidance?

audit-bot: Compliance policy: evidence_retention default=365 days; exceptions require GRC approval. Submit ticket https://gcr.redwood.ai/tickets/PRIV-512 to request >1yr retention.

mike: I'll make retention TTL pluggable via env var and document the cost implications (S3). But we need GRC signoff before we actually keep >365d. Finance heads-up: longer retention will increase storage spend.

lena: Action items recap: Sam -> add schema + tests and update PR #4798; Mike -> add TTL config and link changes to the PR; Zoe -> review PR for schema/attestation details; Lena -> open GRC ticket for 3yr retention and link here.

sam: Assigning to myself, ETA EOD tomorrow for schema + tests.

zoe: I'll review by EOD Friday — ping me if it's ready earlier.

audit-bot: Ticket created PRIV-512 by lena at https://gcr.redwood.ai/tickets/PRIV-512. Status: open.

lena: Thanks all — if anything blocks please @mention here. :thumbsup:
